products.title: Archer Watch Straps - Stainless Steel PVD Replacement Buckle - Choice of Color, Finish, Size
features: EXCEPTIONAL DURABILITY - Congratulations. You’re about to brandish one of the slickest, strongest buckles on the market. Made from corrosion resistant, stainless steel and further coated with a vacuum PVD finish, your brand new buckle from Archer Watch Straps will not crack, chip, or rust. We like to call that a worry-free wear.

VARIETY REFINED - We’ve got a bit of a vibe here at Archer. We like our accessories simple and elegant. Finishing touches that catch the eye, but aren’t overly flashy. So, we’ve pared our selection of premium buckles to reflect that style. With plenty of sleek, stunning colors, and three slick finishes, you can add a dash of detail to perfect your favorite watch strap and time piece combination.

COMPLETE COMPATIBLITY - Each of our buckles come in a variety of sizes, so you can easily slip them on any watch band – Archer or not – that takes a 16mm, 18mm, 19mm, 20mm, 21mm, 22mm, 23mm, or 24mm buckle. Each buckle also comes with both 2mm and 3mm wide tongues, so if your particular band has slightly smaller, or wider punched holes, you won’t have to sacrifice your style.

SIMPLE SET UP - Once you’ve chosen the buckle you like best, the hard part’s over. To attach it, just grab a pin, paperclip, or the straight end of a spring bar tool, and release the spring bar through the holes on the sides of the buckle. Then slot the spring bar into the corresponding holes on your watch strap, and you’re done. To remove it, simply reverse the process. Now, you can swap in whatever buckle you’re ready to rock next.
